abilities.name: thick-fat
abilities.effect: Halves damage from fire and ice moves.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: ice-body
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail.  Protects against hail damage.

kanto.flavorText: It stores thermal energy in the body. It swims at a steady eight knots even in intensely cold waters.

original-johto.flavorText: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.

hoenn.flavorText: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

updated-johto.flavorText: It loves frigid seas with ice floes. It uses its long tail to change swimming direction quickly.

original-unova.flavorText: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its streamlined body has low resistance, and it swims around cold oceans at a speed of eight knots.

kalos.flavorText: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.

updated-alola.flavorText: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
